descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S04 「两个医院病人，从不同的切换做不同的选择：A 上先 Cancel（meds）再 Delete（note），B 上 Keep（tasks）；A 的删除不碰 B；Ask 面板在 Post-Round 上能打开」 Two Hospital patients, a different choice from a different toggle: Cancel (meds) then Delete (note) on A, Keep (tasks) on B; A's delete leaves B untouched; the Ask sheet opens on Post-Round

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 With pending tasks on two patients, 'Delete & complete' on one removes only that patient's pending tasks.（UAT TC-17；TFA-92595 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U4 With pending tasks, 'Mark Encounter Complete' opens the Pending Tasks prompt with three choices, and each works: Delete & complete deletes the pending tasks and completes; …（UAT TC-17；TFA-92595 AC 8；TFA-92595 How it works 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U1 The Note / Tasks / Meds toggle shows only one section at a time, and each section shows its own correct content (the three views hold correct, independent data).（UAT TC-17；TFA-92595 AC 2；TFA-92595 How it works 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T4 'Mark Encounter Complete' is present and functional from all three toggles (Note, Tasks, Meds), not just Note.（TFA-92595 AC 7；TFA-92595 How it works 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T5 The Pending Tasks prompt appears exactly when tasks remain: never with 0 open tasks, always with ≥1, listing the open tasks; never before the encounter's derived tasks are in.（TFA-92595 AC 8；TFA-92595 How it works 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U2 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' sits at the top of Post-Round and behaves like the Encounter-tab Ask (same mechanism as Ask AI). What 'matches' means is Q4. …（UAT TC-17；TFA-92595 How it works 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given One physician, two Hospital patients in note-ready, each with its own note. A has three open tasks from today, one open task carried over from yesterday, one done task and two tracker rows; B has two open tasks, one done task and one tracker row

When A: open 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' and close it; meds toggle → Mark Encounter Complete → Cancel — go back; note toggle → Mark Encounter Complete → Delete Pending Tasks & Complete; tasks toggle. B: tasks and note toggles; then tasks toggle → Mark Encounter Complete → Keep Tasks & Mark Complete; meds toggle; …

Then A: the Ask sheet opens; the prompt from meds lists A's open tasks and none done, none of B's; Cancel completes nothing; after Delete A is complete with only its done task left. B before its own choice: both open tasks and the done task are there, '2 pending tasks', Mark Encounter Complete present, its own note. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint. Table: (A, meds, Cancel) → nothing changes; (A, note, Delete) → A's today-open tasks gone, A's done task kept, A complete; (B, untouched) → B's tasks kept, not complete, own note; (B, tasks, Keep) → B complete, open tasks still open after a reload. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
